title: Comment on "Modeling rapid language learning by distilling Bayesian priors into artificial neural networks"
abstract: arXiv:2608.12974v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: McCoy & Griffiths (2025, henceforth M&G) suggest that a Bayesian prior can be distilled into Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) through Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML, Finn et al., 2017). They support this empirically by showing that meta-trained networks demonstrate formal language learning abilities comparable to Yang & Piantadosi (2023)'s Bayesian learner, significantly outperforming standard ANNs. We point out that under the standard interpretation of a prior, M&G's procedure does not actually instill one; it merely initializes network weights favorably, leaving the objective function unchanged. We then consider a more permissive interpretation, where the system as a whole can be seen as implementing a Bayesian learner even without an explicit prior in the objective. translated_title: 评论：“通过将贝叶斯先验蒸馏进人工神经网络来模拟快速语言学习”
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12974v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：McCoy和Griffiths（2025，以下简称M&G）提出，通过模型无关元学习（MAML，Finn等人，2017），可以将贝叶斯先验蒸馏到人工神经网络（ANNs）中。他们通过实证支持这一观点，表明元训练的网络展示了与Yang和Piantadosi（2023）的贝叶斯学习者相当的形式语言学习能力，显著优于标准ANNs。我们指出，在先验的标准解释下，M&G的程序实际上并未灌输先验；它仅仅有利地初始化了网络权重，使目标函数保持不变。然后，我们考虑一种更宽松的解释，即整个系统可以被视为实现贝叶斯学习者，即使目标中没有显式先验。我们表明，这种解释面临非平凡的挑战。最后，我们评估MAML在多大程度上近似了贝叶斯学习的实证结果，表明...
tldr: 本文评论指出，M&G的方法并未真正将贝叶斯先验蒸馏进神经网络，其初始化权重的方式不符合先验的标准定义，且更宽松解释面临挑战，MAML对贝叶斯学习的近似也存在局限。
en_tdlr: This commentary argues that M&G's method does not truly distill a Bayesian prior into neural networks, as weight initialization does not align with the standard prior definition, and broader interpretations face challenges while MAML's approximation of Bayesian learning has limitations.
